summary.text: Reggie Thomas is a Democratic member of the Kentucky Senate representing District 13, serving since 2014. The legislature's profile lists Thomas as Senate Minority Caucus Chair. The profile name is Reginald L. Thomas.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature's profile, Reginald L. Thomas was born on May 20, 1953, and is an attorney and is listed with Kentucky State University.
The profile lists an A.B. from Dartmouth College (1975) and a J.D. from Harvard (1978).
It also lists the Citizen-Lawyer Award from the Fayette County Bar Association (2019) and induction into the Bryan Station High School Hall of Fame.
